name: ok-asks-whether-the-step-before-stood
query: get [~(5 | ok !| false) ~(!{:k 1} | raise | ok !| false)]

name: error-test-in-a-template
query: get [~(!{:kind :oops} | raise | ok !| false) ~(42 | ok !| false)]

name: a-catch-whose-label-refuses-the-error-at-rest-passes-a-frame-at-its-step
query: :Box |~~ A parcel. ~~| (::kind | holds :k |~~ k. ~~| ~(tag | eq ::map)) | {:a 1} | tag ::Box | raise !| it | count !| trace | map ~(get [~(failed) ~(skipped)])

name: an-error-raised-under-a-label-whose-invariant-refuses-it-at-rest-is-caught-by-that-refusal
query: :Box |~~ A parcel. ~~| (::kind | holds :k |~~ k. ~~| ~(tag | eq ::map)) | {:a 1} | tag ::Box | raise !| it !| get [~(tag) /actualTag]

name: a-catch-whose-label-takes-no-facts-refuses-the-error-at-rest
query: {:a 1} | tag ::P | :v it | :P |~~ P. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ A number. ~~| ::number) | v | raise !| it !| get [~(tag) /actualTag]

name: a-catch-whose-label-takes-maps-alone-refuses-the-error-at-rest
query: :Late |~~ Late. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ The facts. ~~| ::map) | ::Late{:by 3} | raise !| it !| get [~(tag) /actualTag]

name: a-catch-whose-label-takes-errors-holds-the-error-at-rest-under-it
query: :Late |~~ Late. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ The facts. ~~| #[::map ::error]) | ::Late{:by 3} | raise !| get [~(tag) /by]

name: a-raised-map-is-caught-under-the-kind-of-errors-once
query: get [~(!{:a 1} | raise !| payload | tag) ~({:a 1} | raise !| payload | tag)]
